NBA DFS Picks for Sunday, November 15 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 5 games · First game 6:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 8:21 PM ET

Jalen Johnson (ATL) is the top-projected player on the Sunday, November 15 DraftKings main slate at 51.1 DraftKings points for $9,600. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.6, $10,600) and Alperen Sengun (HOU, 48.6, $9,400) are next.

Leaky Black (SAC) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.09 projected points per $1,000 at $3,400.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 8:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
